narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Draw the arc first and the perpendicular later.
<bookmark mark='many'/>Every point on the arc is seven centimetres from B, so which one is the corner?
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The arc alone cannot choose. The perpendicular must cross it to fix one point.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, measure DC with the ruler. It should match AB, and the set square should fit every corner.
<bookmark mark='diag'/>Then draw the other diagonal AC. In a rectangle both diagonals are equal, so it also reads seven centimetres.
